sentences.text:
Under Sections 498A/326/307/34 Of ... vs In Re: Nijam Ali @
Nejam Ali on 7 October, 2024 Author: Soumen Sen

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure read with Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhi  in connection with Lalgola Police Station Case No. 530 of 2024 dated 18.06  under Sections 498A/326/307/34 of Indian Penal Code.
 And  In Re: Nijam Ali @ Nejam Ali  Petitioner  Md. Bani Israil  For the Petitioner  Mr. Manoranjan Mahata  For the State

1.
We have heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case dairy, the statement of the injured in which he has specifically named Yousur Ali and the present petitioner and having regard to the nature of injury,
we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the present petitioner.
3. The prayer for anticipatory bail of the present petitioner is rejected.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
